[SWS_CM_10098]
⌈
Possible values of the type field are defined by the elements of the
Variant. The types are encoded in ascending order starting with 1 reusing the index
encoding format of the Variant incremented by 1. The encoded value 0 is reserved for
the NULL type - i.e. a valueless (empty) Variant.
⌋
